description: Land  Title Settlement Department  - Acharigama, Thambutthegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District  - Cad. Map No. 110083
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of multiple land parcels in specific locations, along with a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, owners (Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority), and title classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
